import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt() % m;
        }
        int h = n / 2;
        Set<Integer> setX = new HashSet<>();
        Set<Integer> setY = new HashSet<>();
        generateSubsetSums(a, 0, h, 0, m, setX);
        generateSubsetSums(a, h, n, 0, m, setY);
        List<Integer> yList = new ArrayList<>(setY);
        Collections.sort(yList);
        int maxVal = 0;
        for (int i : setX) {
            int target = m - i;
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(yList, target);
            if (idx < 0) {
                idx = -idx - 2; // insertion point - 1
            } else {
                idx = idx - 1; // if exact match, we want the one before (since we need < m)
            }
            if (idx >= 0) {
                int j = yList.get(idx);
                maxVal = Math.max(maxVal, (i + j) % m);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxVal);
    }

    private static void generateSubsetSums(int[] a, int start, int end, int sum, int m, Set<Integer> set) {
        if (start == end) {
            set.add(sum % m);
            return;
        }
        generateSubsetSums(a, start + 1, end, (sum + a[start]) % m, m, set);
        generateSubsetSums(a, start + 1, end, sum, m, set);
    }
}
